note: Every reason a test may be skipped for, the most tests it may cover, and who can lift it. A new reason or a larger count fails the run (tools/test/guard.js checkSkips).

no prod-snapshot.owner: data owner — a copy of production data is deliberately not in the repository; run with SDP_SNAPSHOT=1 SDP_TEST_PG_URL=<restored copy>. To share a copy, the data owner (or an operator they name) runs tools/dev/anonymize-snapshot.js on it and approves the result (docs/ops/ANONYMISED-SNAPSHOT.md)

python with matplotlib + python-pptx not.owner: CI owner — CI and release install Python + tools/exec-pptx/requirements.txt (E-Q01), so no skip is allowed; a dev box without Python runs: python -m pip install -r tools/exec-pptx/requirements.txt
